The '''Lorpfan system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Tynquay sector/Legends|Tynquay sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of<ref name="Region" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEA" /> It shared its name with the [[Lorpfan]] [[Desert/Legends|deserts]] of [[Trandosha/Legends|Trandosha]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|259|Trandosha (Dosha)}}</ref>
